_comment: Optional. Map an image filename to the explanation shown after the user answers. If a file isn't listed here, a sensible default reason is used. Filenames are case-sensitive. Only use images that show FICTIONAL organisations - no real bank, company or agency names or logos.
example_bank_sms.png: Real banks never ask for your OTP or PIN, and never freeze a card on a countdown. Both are pressure tactics.
example_gov_legit.png: Genuine: it points to an official government website you can check yourself, and asks for nothing sensitive.
